prose: Loralee Scaife is an astrologer who uses Jungian techniques to analyze mythology, using stories to map the collective unconscious. She's created a video series using The Lord of the Rings as a mythic lens through which we can understand our troubled times. We analyze the nature of evil and our responsibility to stand up in defense of the Life Force itself.
ext: Tolkien's cosmology, the creative purpose of tragedy, lies, and sorrow, the light and shadow of the King archetype, and the myth of Prometheus.
